summary: 26 kept items across 4 banks, all relayed by @MikeZaccardi (no Neil Sethi or dailychartbook items surfaced this cycle). Goldman dominates with 19 items centered on Q2 earnings season: record EPS beat rates, hyperscaler cloud/capex acceleration, and multiple stretched-positioning signals (sentiment indicator, low intramarket correlations, VIX/VIXEQ gap). Yardeni contributes 5 items on continued disinflation (core CPI ex-shelter, cooling core goods) alongside a strong labor market (record total hours worked) even as manufacturing capex diverges toward the AI buildout. Apollo/Slok (1) flags Japan fiscal/USDJPY vol risk; HSBC (1) watches for the seasonal Aug-Oct VIX pattern. By bank: Goldman 19, Yardeni 5, Apollo/Slok 1, HSBC 1.
